description_en: Queries the details of Anti-DDoS Origin instances
description_zh: 查询DDoS原生防护实例的详情
name: DescribeInstanceList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the default resource group is used
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query. Specify the value in the `["<Instance ID 1>","<Instance ID 2>",……]` format
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID列表。使用`["<实例ID 1>","<实例ID 2>",……]`格式表示
parameters.name: instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The remark of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的备注。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Settings the current page number
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: The number of instances on each page in a paging query. Settings the number of instances per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The protocol type of the IP assets protected by the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4 protocol.
IPv6: IPv6 protocol
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例防护的IP资产的协议类型。取值：

IPv4：表示IPv4协议。
IPv6：表示IPv6协议
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan type of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query. Valid values:

0: Professional.
1: Enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护套餐类型。取值：

0：表示专业版。
1：表示企业版
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The protected IP address of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护对象IP
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en:
The sort field for the Anti-DDoS Origin instance list. The value is fixed as expireTime, which indicates sorting by instance expiration time.

You can use the Orderdire parameter to specify the sort order
parameters.help_zh:
设置DDoS原生防护实例列表的排序字段。取值固定为expireTime，表示按照实例的到期时间排序。

您可以通过Orderdire参数设置排序方式。
parameters.name: orderby

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

desc (default): descending order by expiration time.
asc: ascending order by expiration time
parameters.help_zh:
设置排序方式。取值：

desc（默认）：表示按照到期时间降序排序。
asc：表示按照到期时间升序排序
parameters.name: orderdire

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin.
-
<notice>This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the API returns DDosBgp.CheckError.InvalidRegion(400).</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
-
<notice>本参数为必填项，未提供时 API 将返回 DDosBgp.CheckError.InvalidRegion(400)</notice>
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The key of the tag bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query
fields.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query
fields.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags bound to the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例绑定的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The mitigation plan types of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的防护套餐类型
parameters.name: instance_type_list

InstanceList.description_en: The details of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances
InstanceList.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的详情列表

items.description_en: The details of the Anti-DDoS Origin instances
items.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的详情列表

Events.description_en: The events on which automatic binding is based

items.description_en:
The event on which automatic binding is based. Valid values:

any: Automatic binding based on scrubbing or blackhole filtering events.
clean: Automatic binding based on scrubbing events.
blackhole: Automatic binding based on blackhole filtering events
items.description_zh:
自动绑定基于的事件。取值：

any：表示基于清洗或者黑洞事件绑定。
clean：表示基于清洗事件自动绑定。
blackhole：表示基于黑洞事件自动绑定

AutoRenewal.description_en:
Indicates whether auto-renewal is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
AutoRenewal.description_zh:
实例是否已开启自动续费。取值：

true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

BlackholdingCount.description_en:
The number of IP addresses that are in blackhole filtering status among the assets that are assigned public IP addresses protected by the instance.

You can invoke [DeleteBlackhole]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118692.html） to deactivate blackhole filtering for a single protected IP address
BlackholdingCount.description_zh:
实例防护的公网IP资产中，处于黑洞状态的IP的数量。

您可以调用[DeleteBlackhole]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118692.html）为单个受保护IP解除黑洞状态

CommodityType.description_en:
The commodity type of the instance.

ddos_ddosorigin_public_cn: Anti-DDoS Origin 2.0 (Pay-as-you-go) China site.
ddos_ddosorigin_public_intl: Anti-DDoS Origin 2.0 (Pay-as-you-go) International site
CommodityType.description_zh:
实例的商品类型。

ddos_ddosorigin_public_cn：表示DDoS原生防护2.0（后付费）中国站。
ddos_ddosorigin_public_intl：表示DDoS原生防护2.0（后付费）国际站

CoverageType.description_en:
The asset overwrite type of the instance.

1: Supports assets that are assigned public IP addresses in multiple regions globally.
2: Supports assets that are assigned public IP addresses in multiple regions in the Chinese mainland.
3: Supports assets that are assigned public IP addresses in multiple regions outside the Chinese mainland.
4: Supports assets that are assigned public IP addresses in a single region globally
CoverageType.description_zh:
实例的资产覆盖类型。

1：表示支持全球多个地域的公网IP资产。
2：表示支持中国内地多个地域的公网IP资产。
3：表示支持非中国内地多个地域的公网IP资产。
4：表示支持全球一个地域的公网IP资产

DebtStatus.description_en:
The overdue payment status. Valid values:

0: No overdue payment.
1: Overdue payment
DebtStatus.description_zh:
欠费状态。取值：

0：未欠费。
1：欠费

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 实例的到期时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

GmtCreate.description_en: The purchase time of the instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
GmtCreate.description_zh: 实例的购买时间。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒

InstanceType.description_en:
The mitigation plan type of the instance. Valid values:

0: Professional.
1: Enterprise
InstanceType.description_zh:
实例的防护套餐类型。取值：

0：表示专业版。
1：表示企业版

IpType.description_en:
The protocol type of the IP assets protected by the instance. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4 protocol.
IPv6: IPv6 protocol
IpType.description_zh:
实例防护的IP资产的协议类型。取值：

IPv4：表示IPv4协议。
IPv6：表示IPv6协议

Product.description_en:
The type of the cloud service associated with the instance. This parameter is not returned by default. It is returned only when the Anti-DDoS Origin instance is created by another cloud service, with the corresponding cloud service code.

Valid values:

gamebox: The Anti-DDoS Origin instance is created by Game Security Box.
eip: The Anti-DDoS Origin instance is created by an EIP with Anti-DDoS (Enhanced) enabled
Product.description_zh:
实例关联的云产品类型。默认不返回该参数，只有当DDoS原生防护实例通过其他云产品创建时，才会返回对应云产品的代码。

取值：

gamebox：表示该DDoS原生防护实例通过游戏安全盒服务创建。
eip：表示该DDoS原生防护实例通过DDoS防护（增强版）EIP实例创建

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

1: Normal.
2: Expired.
3: Released
Status.description_zh:
实例的状态。取值：

1：表示正常。
2：表示已过期。
3：表示已释放

Total.description_en: The total number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances returned
Total.description_zh: 查询到的DDoS原生防护实例的总数量
